frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A long-forward payoff at maturity is linear in S_T: payoff = S_T - K per contract; short pays K - S_T. Under risk-neutral pricing the fair forward price on a non-dividend-paying asset is F_0 = S_0 · e^{rT}. A futures contract has the same terminal payoff but trades on an exchange with daily mark-to-market — the single payoff becomes a path of daily margin cashflows.
